title: Project Management Dashboard
description: A responsive project management app with an interactive Kanban board, real-time notifications, and Chart.js analytics for sprint velocity, task completion, and team performance.

title: SmartCare Hospital Management System
description: A full-stack hospital management system built for Smart India Hackathon 2025, with emergency-focused workflows, role-based access control, patient-doctor portals, appointment scheduling, and medical records.

title: Diabetic Retinopathy Severity Classification
description: A CNN transfer-learning model that classifies diabetic retinopathy severity from retinal images, with a TensorFlow Lite mobile deployment for real-time predictions.
